headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally Near 1% Driven by Strong Foreign Inflows and Q2 Earnings Optimism

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign institutional investor (FII/FPI) inflows surged, driving Sensex to nine-month highs.
Optimism around positive second-quarter (Q2) financial results fueled market sentiment.
Financial and auto sector stocks led the broad rally across benchmark indices.
GIFT Nifty indicated a positive start for the trading session on November 12.
whatHappening: Sensex rallied up to 1,302 points while Nifty crossed the 25,300 mark.
MSCI added Coforge, LIC, Adani Green, and Meesho in its November index rejig.
Systematix maintained a 'Buy' rating on Data Patterns citing a record order book supporting H2 performance.
Global cues showed Asian markets advancing while Nvidia fell following reports concerning top executives.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty jumped nearly 1% as foreign institutional investors poured funds into the market. Auto and banking stocks spearheaded the gains alongside positive Q2 corporate earnings. Key stock developments included MSCI index additions and favorable analyst coverage.
